meta.name: POC-02 结构化抽取验证语料
meta.description: 24 条合成询盘（12 中文 + 12 英文），全部为人工编写的演示数据，不含任何真实客户询盘或个人数据。golden 为人工标注的期望抽取值；null 表示原文未提及该字段。

items.subject: 无线耳机采购询价
items.raw_text: 你好，我们想采购 500 副无线蓝牙耳机，需要印我们的 Logo，发到德国，请报 FOB 深圳价。

items.subject: 智能手表报价请求
items.raw_text: 您好，请提供智能手表的报价。产品需要支持心率监测和 GPS，出口到法国市场。

items.subject: 蓝牙音箱批量采购意向
items.raw_text: 我们计划采购一批蓝牙音箱，数量大概几千台，主要卖到东南亚。

items.subject: 智能摄像头报价（含交期与认证）
items.raw_text: 请报 1000 台智能摄像头的价格，FOB 宁波。我们要求 6 月底前交货，产品需 CE 认证。

items.subject: 智能门铃采购（目标价）
items.raw_text: 我们公司想买 2000 个智能门铃，目标价 15 美元以内，出货到美国。包装需要定制彩盒。

items.subject: 便携式咖啡机产品咨询
items.raw_text: 请问贵司有没有做便携式咖啡机？请发产品目录过来。

items.subject: 智能手环多市场采购
items.raw_text: 我们想采购 3000 条智能手环，主要市场是德国和波兰，交期希望 5 月前。

items.subject: 儿童平板定制采购
items.raw_text: 请报价 800 台儿童平板电脑，发往德国（CIF 汉堡），需要预装我们的教育软件和定制开机画面。

golden.customization_needs: 预装教育软件和定制开机画面

items.subject: 智能水杯起订量咨询
items.raw_text: 你们的智能水杯最小起订量是多少？我们想先试单，出口到日本。

items.subject: 智能灯带采购（EXW）
items.raw_text: 采购 1500 套智能灯带，EXW 广州，要求 4 月底交货，需要 CE 和 RoHS 证书。

items.subject: 安卓平板规格采购
items.raw_text: 您好，我们需要 600 台 10.1 英寸安卓平板，4GB+64GB，支持蓝牙 5.3，用于出口到巴西，请报 DDP 价。

items.subject: 翻译耳机批量询价
items.raw_text: 你好，我对你们的翻译耳机感兴趣，想了解批量采购的价格，主要面向中东市场，交期越快越好。

items.subject: Wireless earbuds quote
items.raw_text: Hi, we are looking for 2,000 units of wireless earbuds with our logo printed, shipping to the UK. Please quote FOB Shenzhen.

items.subject: Smart watch quotation request
items.raw_text: Hello, could you send us a quotation for smart watches with heart rate monitoring? We sell in the French market.

items.subject: Bluetooth speakers bulk intent
items.raw_text: We plan to order a batch of Bluetooth speakers, several thousand pieces, mainly for Southeast Asia.

items.subject: Security cameras quote with deadline
items.raw_text: Please quote 1,000 smart security cameras, FOB Ningbo. Delivery by end of June is required, CE certified.

items.subject: Video doorbells with target price
items.raw_text: Our company wants to buy 2,000 video doorbells with a target price under 15 USD, shipping to the US. Custom color box packaging needed.

items.subject: Portable coffee machine catalog
items.raw_text: Do you manufacture portable coffee machines? Please send us your catalog.

items.subject: Smart wristbands multi-market
items.raw_text: We want to purchase 3,000 smart wristbands for the German and Polish markets, delivery before May.

items.subject: Kids tablets customization
items.raw_text: Please quote 800 kids tablets for Germany (CIF Hamburg) with our educational software pre-installed and custom boot screen.

golden.customization_needs: educational software pre-installed and custom boot screen

items.subject: Smart water bottle MOQ
items.raw_text: What is your MOQ for smart water bottles? We want to start with a trial order for Japan.

items.subject: LED strip kits EXW order
items.raw_text: We need 1,500 smart LED strip kits, EXW Guangzhou, delivery by end of April, with CE and RoHS certificates.

items.subject: Android tablets with specs
items.raw_text: We require 600 units of 10.1-inch Android tablets, 4GB+64GB, Bluetooth 5.3, for export to Brazil. Please quote DDP.

items.subject: Translator earbuds bulk pricing
items.raw_text: Hi, I'm interested in your translator earbuds and would like bulk pricing. We mainly target the Middle East, delivery as soon as possible.
